title: Baguio creates task force to monitor sale of imported agricultural crops

blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Mayor Benjamin Magalong created a city task force to monitor the sale of imported agricultural crops in Baguio and ensure compliance with national importation, sanitary and phytosanitary regulations. In a statement on Friday, Nov. 6, the Baguio Public Information Office said Magalong issued Executive Order No. 177, series of 2026, on Wednesday, creating the Baguio Imported Agricultural Crop Commodities Compliance and Monitoring (BIACOMM) Task Force.
